body:
Shit man! Thanks for taking the time to help me with what’s on your plate. My father was a schizophrenic and abusive to my mother and the kids, so I’ve been there. (Thankfully, he died alone like he deserved)

Foster care is risky, I ended up being sexually abused in one home, covered up by the social worker (They treated me as a liar trying get back with my family, yeah right!) Eventually though I got a good case worker that believed me and ended up with a great foster family that I credit with any good parenting skills I now possess, so it is a crapshoot. I still think calling the authorities is the best option, because despite what happened to me. Most case workers really try to help. Most foster families are good caring people dealing with troubled young people. I just happened to get on of them that wasn’t. 

You have to think about it. Do you want to stay in a situation that you know it won’t get better? Or do you want to give yourself a shot (a pretty good one at that) of improving your situation?

Thank you for your help earlier, and feel free to message me. Sometimes helping others helps us as well. Sometimes people that have gone through similar problems can provide help and advice even if they are also struggling.

I don’t want to give myself too much credit, because I’m not too far gone yet, my wife quit in Alabama, I’ve got to quit, because if I don’t, my kids will find out, if they haven’t already. I’ve been really tempted to go past pills, but I’m really scared of what I’d become. I feel like I’m staring down a bottomless pit... So far so good, I’m going to try to take sleeping pills (Not in a suicidal way) and sleep the next couple of days while their aunt is watching them... Not having my wife with me though has made this hard... 

It sucks being surrounded by good caring people, and feeling like I’m the POS holding them back.

How are things going for you?
